next_action.description: Preserve the expanded local validation, receipt-integrity, export-catalog, and validation-desk capabilities; complete the still-open controlled physical test print of the Pico 2 enclosure fit assembly and record fit, clearance, slicer profile, and revision evidence before claiming physical validation.

blockers: The physical validation gate still requires a controlled Pico 2 enclosure fit test print.
Fit, clearance, slicer profile, and revision evidence must come from the physical print; expanded software validation does not substitute for that evidence.
Local CI receipts provide artifact-integrity evidence but are not source attestations or product-readiness evidence.
The drip-tray basin and grid remain physically unverified for drainage behavior, counter-edge fit, dispenser fit, and printability.
